name: When is it necessary to widen doorways for walker accessibility?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to widen doorways for walker accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: It becomes necessary to widen doorways for walker accessibility when an individual in the home uses a walker or other mobility device that cannot comfortably or safely pass through existing doorways. This may be due to aging, injury, or a disability. Proactive modifications can significantly improve quality of life, prevent falls, and allow for greater independence and ease of movement within the home environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Widen doorways when a resident uses a walker and current openings are too narrow for safe, comfortable, and independent passage.
